neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: run-003 asset-three-quarter.png and asset-detail.png show one broad dark slab, plain box columns, and feet with little photographic material character.

close_inspection.evidence: The profile/detail renders show hard-edged plate-like supports and few clearly resolved manufactured joins; the v007 evaluation itself calls the details 'simple but deliberate'.

edge_treatment.evidence: The desktop reads as a single sharp-edged slab instead of the softened, finished glass edge in the brief.

joins.evidence: The columns, feet, and rails read as adjoining box forms; their load-bearing joints are not convincingly finished.

thickness.evidence: The measured 0.72-inch desktop thickness is plausible, though its edge finish is not.

hardware.evidence: Mount discs are present but the production view does not resolve believable fasteners or fittings.

material_response.evidence: The broad top has weak, localized highlights and does not show the wide soft room/window reflections seen on the source glass.

surface_variation.evidence: Glass and frame read as broad uniform color fields; there is little credible glass or coating variation.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The render lacks convincing edge finishing, fitted joins, wiring, fasteners, and visible production detail at close scale.

photo_character.evidence: Source photo photo_holder/Sample (2).jpg shows broad window and monitor reflections in the smoked-glass top plus black T supports. v007's room render shows a mostly uniform dark plane and generic support geometry.

visual_gate.style_evidence: The v007 evaluation explicitly described restrained low-poly geometry, a more stylized result than the photo, and simple deliberate details; production images support that classification. The desk brief does not authorize stylization.

challenger_context.summary: A materially different CAD-like geometry plus procedural PBR map method was tested and did not yet pass; desk-v007 remains the best-so-far registry incumbent.
